about_the_game:
Go beyond the boundaries of Nahverkehr Dresden and accelerate westbound all the way to Leipzig in Train Sim World 6. Drive modern ICE, regional and freight traffic along the oldest long-distance railway in Germany.

Built in 1839, the Leipzig-Dresden railway was the first long-distance line in Germany, and one of the oldest in the country. Over time the line earned a reputation for being one of the busiest as well, and its age meant it has seen many improvements to keep up with demand. Today, it is a modern commuter network and LZB-equipped intercity line in one.

Variety abounds for such a diverse network, with multiple trains operating different services, and on diverging lines. The innovative ICE-T is the main express traffic between Dresden and Leipzig, using the avoiding line in the East and LZB in the West. Regional services are often handled with the iconic BR 442, which also operated local services towards Großenhain. Loco-hauled Dostos get double duty, operating both regional and S-bahn S1 services.

In Train Sim World 6, become a driver or conductor aboard DB ICE and regional services. Wind through the multiple paths from Dresden to Riesa, then keep the journey going with a high-speed dash to Leipzig. Drive freight, serve industries and navigate the large Friedrichstadt yard. Operate local S-Bahn trains to Meißen.

Key Features


  • 160+ km network-style route from Leipzig Hbf to Dresden Hbf, including;
    • New 65 km extension from Riesa to Leipzig
    • Both 54 km mainline and 23 km avoiding line between Dresden and Riesa
    • New addition of 13 km Dresden - Coswig line via Friedrichstadt
    • 4 km line to Großenhain and the 9 km S1 branch to Meißen
    • Plus various yards and railway-served industries
  • Featuring 42 detailed stations with audible passenger announcements
  • DB BR 411 ICE-T EMU in DB ICE livery
  • DB BR 442 EMU in DB red livery
  • DB BR 146.2, BR 143 Locos and Doppelstock coaches in DB red livery
  • MRCE BR 185.2 in MRCE black livery
  • DB BR 363 Diesel Shunter in DBB Blue livery
  • Highly detailed, feature-rich, driving cabs
  • True-to-life performance, suspension and handling
  • Accessible Tutorials on the Training Center
  • Audible on-board announcements and passenger ambience
  • A number of engaging Scenarios and an authentic Timetable
  • Journey Mode tying together Training, Scenarios and Timetabled Services
  • Additional timetable layers adding playable IC traffic using the original DB BR 101, Leipzig S-Bahn traffic using the BR 1442, and extra freight services with the Railpool Vectron and DB BR 294 (each available separately)
  • Timetable gameplay can be influenced by random events
  • A selection of Route Tasks to complete
  • Explore the route and trains in Free Roam
  • Livery Designer, Formation Designer and Scenario Planner compatible. Share your creations with the Creators Club
  • Powered by Dovetail Games’ proprietary SimuGraph® vehicle dynamics engine and Unreal Engine 4® technology
  • Download size: 11.5 GB
